_comment: Estavo v3 — the single illustrative property record.
_rule: Visual Theme Plan v1 §4.1: one record is the recurring visual anchor across Home, Data, Market, Websites and AI, and the same record must use the same value everywhere. Master Plan v3 §7.1 forbids pairing a real project name with invented prices, availability or payment plans.
_status: ILLUSTRATIVE PLACEHOLDER — NOT APPROVED PRODUCT DATA
_before_publishing: Replace with an approved record from the source of truth defined in Master Plan v3 §11 (owner: Data).
Master Plan v3 §7.2 requires the price basis to be explicit: starting price, unit-specific, cash or instalment.
Until replaced, every surface rendering this record MUST show the component-level label in `label_ar`/`label_en`.
Do not remove the label to make the page look more finished. The label is what makes the placeholder honest.

record.price_basis_en: [price basis: set by the approved source]

_images._rule: Visual Theme Plan v1 §4.5: every image needs an owner, permission state and intended route; a real project name does not grant rights to unrelated architecture.
_images._status: proj-a/b/c.jpg and site-1/2/3.jpg are existing generic assets, used here as unattributed illustrative imagery only. They are not paired with any real project name.
